patent.title: CRISPR-Cas systems and methods for altering expression of gene products
patent.family_note: Anchor patent for the portfolio-dependency stress test. PTAB Count 1 specifically references claim 18, but Interference 106,115 involves a much larger Broad/CVC patent/application set.

knowledge_origin.description: This ledger does not attempt to reconstruct the full multi-lab scientific genealogy of CRISPR-Cas9.

technology.problem: Enable programmable CRISPR-Cas9 cleavage/editing of target DNA in eukaryotic cells.
technology.mechanism: PTAB Count 1 includes a single-guide-RNA CRISPR-Cas9 system capable of cleaving or editing target DNA in a eukaryotic cell.

value_carriers.name: Editas in-licensed Broad Cas9 patent estate
value_carriers.description: PTAB lists US8697359 among the Broad patents in Interference 106,115; Editas reports that the involved Broad patents are in-licensed by Editas.

value_carriers.name: CASGEVY (exagamglogene autotemcel)
value_carriers.description: Public filings establish a CASGEVY-related Broad/Harvard portfolio sublicense and a broader multi-portfolio CRISPR IP stack, but do not publicly apportion or explicitly map US8697359 individually to CASGEVY.

value_links.note: Confirms a rights transaction / in-license relationship at the exact-patent set level; it does not establish product implementation.
Portfolio-level CASGEVY licensing is public, but an exact public US8697359 → CASGEVY implementation/apportionment link is not established here.

value_metrics.note: Product revenue is not inherited by US8697359.

value_metrics.metric_name: CASGEVY-related Editas Cas9 license upfront payment
value_metrics.note: Portfolio/field license consideration. It must not be treated as US8697359 value or split mechanically across portfolio patents.

gaps.description: Public records establish that US8697359 sits inside an in-licensed Broad Cas9 patent estate and that CASGEVY is covered by a broader multi-portfolio licensing stack, but do not establish the exact US8697359 → CASGEVY implementation/contribution link.
needed_evidence: patent schedule for the CASGEVY sublicense
claim chart to CASGEVY editing/manufacturing steps

gaps.description: CASGEVY revenue and the Editas-Vertex portfolio license consideration cannot be apportioned to US8697359 from public evidence.

V0.7 cannot represent that the economic/legal position depends on a network spanning multiple Broad patents, CVC patents/applications, ToolGen and Sigma claims, multiple licenses, ongoing appeals/interferences, and jurisdiction-specific validity outcomes.

notes: H3 stress-test anchor. Standalone V0.7 analysis stops at R2 for US8697359 even though the surrounding portfolio/license network is connected to a commercial CRISPR product. This is intentional: portfolio-level implementation, revenue and licensing economics must not be inherited by one patent.
